subspaces.P_SRM: W W^T (exact frozen O2 vision-derived target mapping)
subspaces.P_VIS_FULL: projector of ALL nonzero right-singular vectors of centered TRAIN vision identity centroids (rank<=9)
subspaces.P_IMG_FULL: same for centered TRAIN imagery centroids; imagery used ONLY for post-hoc geometry, never O2 fit

retention_formulas.generic: ||delta P||^2 / ||delta||^2 on held-out identity contrast delta (target std native)
retention_formulas.R_Y_SRM: imagery retention in frozen SRM (reproduces O2.1)
retention_formulas.R_Y_VISFULL: imagery retention in full visual identity span (NEW critical)

vision_rank_curve: held-out R_X_VIS(k), R_Y_VIS(k) for k=1..rank_VIS_FULL ordered by TRAIN vision singular value; descriptive, NO selection
principal_angles: projector-based sign-invariant cos(theta_j) of B_VIS_FULL vs B_IMG_FULL; mean_sq_cos, min_cos, max_angle, chordal; CROSS_STATE_SUBSPACE_OVERLAP=||Bv^T Bi||_F^2/min(rank)

reliability.split: FIXED odd vs even of the 8 imagery repeats (no search)
reliability.primary: cross-half identical-identity pattern correlation across voxels/components, averaged equally over 12 identities
reliability.noise_ceiling: descriptive from odd/even; NOT a primary inferential statistic

rdm.LOSO_sharedness: Spearman(upper-tri RDM_s, mean upper-tri RDM_other_7); participant is the unit; NO 28-pair pseudoreplication

O1_replay_contract.exact: deterministic frozen O1 O4 re-selection (operator_o1 select_hyperparams/fit_operator); verify recomputed O4 held-out r vs committed within 1e-8
O1_replay_contract.decompose: Yhat_O1 and Y_true split by P_VIS_FULL -> parallel/perp; G_O1_PARALLEL=r_parallel_O4-r_parallel_O0; G_O1_PERP=r_perp_O4-r_perp_O0

regimes.A_SRM_DIMENSION_TRUNCATION_DOMINANT: R_Y_VISFULL high AND R_Y_SRM low AND SRM_TRUNCATION_LOSS large
regimes.B_STATE_SPECIFIC_SHARED_GEOMETRY_OUTSIDE: R_Y_VISFULL low AND outside reliability moderate/high AND outside LOSO-RDM sharedness moderate/high
regimes.C_SUBJECT_SPECIFIC_IMAGERY_GEOMETRY: R_Y_VISFULL low AND outside reliable AND outside cross-subject sharedness low
regimes.D_IMAGERY_MEASUREMENT_LIMITED: R_Y_VISFULL low AND outside reliability low

identifiability_rule: IDENTIFIABLE requires a frozen observed relationship predicting the state-specific residual ORIENTATION from vision-derived quantities WITHOUT target imagery; shared RDM geometry alone is NOT sufficient
O3_lock: O3_NOT_READY MUST remain through O2.2; explaining the bottleneck does not make O3 ready
